# AI Usage 0.5.0
This release shows when a session will run out early, and fixes Antigravity and Cursor.
- Show when a session is on pace to run out before it resets. Its card reads "Out 57m" beside the reset time, and an hourglass marks it there and in the menu bar. The estimate comes from the current reading, so nothing is stored, and weekly and monthly limits don't get one. - Fix Antigravity showing 100% left while Antigravity itself showed usage. AI Usage now reads the Google host that counts Antigravity's usage, and Argon Weekly appears on accounts where it was missing. - Stop reporting an expired Cursor session on Cursor 3.27 and later, which encrypt the editor's login. AI Usage uses the Cursor CLI's login instead: install the Cursor CLI and run `agent login` once. - Say when a Claude organization doesn't allow OAuth sign-ins, instead of asking you to log in again.
Thanks to mg-i-ant-mor, whale9820, arthurnunesc, and tomaszkotecki-dp for their reports and contributions.

# AI Usage 0.4.0
This release adds Kiro and lets you put your providers in your own order.
- Add Kiro's monthly credits, free-trial credits, and overage spend, using the sign-in Kiro or `kiro-cli` already has, or `KIRO_API_KEY`. - Drag the handle beside each provider in Settings to reorder them. The usage panel and the menu bar follow the same order. With VoiceOver, use the Move Up and Move Down actions.
Thanks to whale9820 and abdullayevilkin for these contributions.

# AI Usage 0.3.2
This release keeps your other sign-ins intact when AI Usage renews a login.
- Keep Claude Code's MCP server logins when AI Usage renews your Claude login. Earlier versions dropped them, so Claude Code asked you to sign in to each MCP server again. - Keep the rest of Grok's sign-in file when AI Usage renews its token, and leave a login Grok renewed in the meantime untouched. Grok's rate limits now show as rate limits. - Stop reporting an expired Antigravity session when Google only declines to share the plan. AI Usage now asks both Google hosts before treating a token as refused. - Keep the Update button's label readable on its blue glass.
Thanks to straki and whale9820 for these fixes.

# AI Usage 0.3.1
This release keeps the providers AI Usage starts tracking after an update.
- Remember newly supported providers after a relaunch. Since 0.2.0, Cursor, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Devin, and Grok could stop being tracked the next time AI Usage opened, and 0.3.0 did the same to Z.ai. - Track them again once on installations where they were dropped. A provider you turn off in Settings stays off.

# AI Usage 0.3.0
This release brings every provider up to date and adds Z.ai.
- Show banked Claude Code and Codex usage-limit resets, when each one expires, and an orange warning in the day before the next one expires. - Add Z.ai GLM Coding Plan session, weekly, and web search limits, using the key Claude Code or OpenCode is already set up with. - Restore Antigravity's Gemini limits and plan, add the Argon weekly quota, and read a running Antigravity app or `agy` CLI when Google withholds an account's quota instead of reporting it as signed out. - Show Claude Code's weekly usage in the menu bar on accounts without a session window. - Use current plan names: Claude Max and Ultra, and Codex Pro 100, 200, and 500. - Show Claude Code extra usage in your billing currency and Cursor on-demand spend, and hide Codex credits on accounts without them. - Show fully used Devin quotas, explain Grok team accounts, and treat GitHub's rate limits as rate limits instead of expired sign-ins. - Wait progressively longer after repeated Claude rate limits. - Use the official Copilot, Devin, and Grok marks, and keep provider cards inside the panel while scrolling.
Thanks to cneren, rafalozan0, whale9820, ofelipeguimaraes, and eurekarex018 for their reports and contributions.
